group.name: Wasted Lab
group.description:
WASTED is a simple way to turn your glass-, paper-, textiles- and plastic waste into discounts and rewards at local retailers, shops, restaurants and cafes.
For every bag of waste that you separate, you receive a digital coin, which can be exchanged to discounts & benefits at WASTED Rewarders. Check the rewards page to find out where you can earn your discount. For example, you can get discounts on coffee, beers, events, soups, bike repairs, massage, yoga lessons, bitterballen, dinners, tools, furniture and more!
